recipe.visualDefinition: A low-angle, close-up portrait of a figure with vibrant blue hair and futuristic eyewear, framed within a circular metallic chrome porthole against a starry cosmic background, featuring high-gloss 3D typography.
coreVisualRelationships: The circular chrome frame acts as a portal between a soft-lit foreground and a deep-space background.
The warm skin tones and orange light leak contrast sharply with the cool blue hair and dark space void.
The arched chrome typography follows the curvature of the central circular frame.
coreInvariants: Chrome metallic textures on all borders and text
Low-angle perspective looking up at the subject
Starry nebula background visible only through the circular aperture

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered portrait, filling 70% of the circular frame, viewed from a dramatic low angle.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The circular chrome frame with its heavy bevel and specular highlights.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the arched top text, moves down to the blue hair, follows the facial features to the chin, and rests on the bottom text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Soft, light-blue gradient surrounding the central porthole.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Light blue-grey background and skin tones.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black and navy space background with white stars.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Electric blue hair and warm orange light leak on the right side of the face.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value, low saturation background vs. high saturation, low value space interior.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extended, ultra-wide sans-serif with geometric curves.
letterConstructionRules: Parallel double-line detailing within the stroke
Arched baseline for the top display text
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are sheared to follow the radial perspective of the arch
Sharp, angular terminals on horizontal strokes

composition.position: Arched over the top of the circle

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Matching 3D chrome styles for both top and bottom text, varying only in scale and arching.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the base geometric wide skeleton for modification.
Captures the specific liquid-metal aesthetic of the era.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a low-angle portrait of a person with electric blue curly hair wearing futuristic wrap-around sunglasses and a white high-collar jacket. Place them inside a circular chrome porthole. The background inside the circle should be a dark starry space with a warm orange glow on one side. The area outside the circle should be a clean, soft light-blue gradient.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply 3D chrome-textured, ultra-wide geometric text arched over the top of the circle and a smaller version horizontally at the bottom. The text should have a double-line metallic effect.

verificationChecks: Is the text arched perfectly to match the circular frame?
Does the chrome texture have realistic specular highlights?
Is the low-angle perspective maintained in the portrait?
Is the blue hair color vibrant and saturated?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features to avoid likeness
Unique letterform details to avoid font licensing issues
postGenerationChecks: Check for consistent lighting between the subject and the chrome frame.
Ensure the 3D text extrusion matches the perspective of the arch.
Verify the star field does not bleed outside the circular frame.
Confirm the orange light leak appears on both the subject and the inner edge of the frame.
recipe.reuseFormula: Low-angle portrait + Circular chrome aperture + Cosmic interior + Arched 3D metallic typography = Y2K Cyber-Futurist Aesthetic.
